messages:
maya_k: Quick check — final prep for Thursday 10am PT candidate (SWE infra). Need scribe + backup interviewer + rubric clarifications. Can people confirm?

jonah: I can scribe. Added to calendar. :white_check_mark:

priya: I can take backup interviewer slot if needed. Which takehome vs live coding split?

maya_k: Thanks @jonah! Priya — it's 30m live coding (pair) + 20m behavioral. Prep doc: https://redwood.app/interviews/kits/infra-swe

samir: Small rubric ask — for live coding, do we score on "design tradeoffs" separate from "correctness"? Last time some confusion.

maya_k: Good call. Let's use these anchors:
```
- correctness: 0-4
- design & tradeoffs: 0-3
- communication & clarity: 0-2
- follow-up questions: 0-1
```
Also call out 'hints' policy: up to 2 small hints, deduct 0.5 each in 'follow-up'.

elena: That breakdown looks fine. Can we get a short note for interviewers to avoid giving solution snippets? One-liner in calendar invite?

maya_k: Yes — adding note now. Calendar invite updated.

peopleops-bot: Reminder set: 'Interview prep checklist' will send 24h before meeting.

priya: One more — do we have an accessible test account for prod-sim? I don't want candidate to need auth.

jonah: I created a read-only test org, creds in 1Password (candidates/infra-readonly). Mentioned in prep doc.

maya_k: All set. Thanks team. If anything else ping me here. :pray:
